name: Interpolate bad channels
summary: Interpolates bad channels in raw MEG/EEG data with MNE-Python interpolate_bads and outputs the repaired raw .fif with a PSD plot.
description: Combines the channels already marked bad in the file with any listed in the bads parameter and reconstructs them with raw.interpolate_bads (spherical splines for EEG, field mapping for MEG). Use it after marking bad channels and before analyses that need a complete channel set. Bad channels must be marked in the input or given via bads; channel positions are required.

inputs.description: Continuous MEG/EEG data in MNE raw .fif format.
inputs.requirements: Bad channels must be listed in info['bads'] or in the bads parameter; sensor positions are needed for interpolation.

outputs.description: Raw data (raw.fif) with the bad channels interpolated.

parameters.description: Optional list of bad channels to interpolate (in addition to those listed in the dataset raw.info['bads'])

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, Heinsfeld AS, et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nat Methods 21:809-813 (2024).
Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7:267 (2013).
